title: Archive through May 22, 2002 - Anonymous (Wednesday, May 22, 2002 - 09:31 pm)
content: I laid in the bath tub of my apt. After taking a bottle of sleeping pills, Tylenol pm and washing it down with a fifth of vodka. I got in the tub with a razor blade and began by cutting my right wrist. It was harder than I anticipated so I had to cut several times before I felt it was enough. I then switched hands and, by the time I was ready to cut my left wrist I was angry at how long this process seem to be taking. I gave a heavy handed slice and there it was. I watched with my eyes open wide, not blinking. I watched the vertical gash of skin literally part away for each side. The blood seemed to pour out in slow motion and finally, I could lay back and close my eyes. I remember feeling very cold. That was the last thought in my head before seeing a set of what I recognized to be headlights. They seemed so far away. They got closer and brighter and stayed suspended. I clearly remember waiting to see Jesus. Suddenly the lights went into a reverse pattern. I watched as they slowly extinguished. Two hours after I got into that bathtub I was discovered by my roommate who had gotten off of work early. I was rushed to the emergency room for sutures, a transfusion and, a 4 week stay in the phsyc. ward. Since that experience I have a heightened awareness and keen intuitive skills that I respect and listen to, finally. I realized laying in the E.R. holding down the charcole cocktail that I had forgotten to fill the tub with water. Had I remembered my wrists would not have been able to clot slowing the bleeding. How could you have been so stupid, I thought to myself. 7 years later I am a successful businesswoman, living in a new town, and I have a beautiful little 16 month girl. I have finally accepted that the pain of the past doesn't ever move you forward until you let God and let go. I am not a religious person, but what other explanation could there be for the road I have traveled?

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A set of lights recognized as headlights, far away, getting closer and brighter, then reversing and slowly extinguishing.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Overdose (sleeping pills and Tylenol PM with vodka) and wrist-cutting with a razor blade in a bathtub.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived distant 'headlights' approaching and brightening, then reversing and extinguishing; expectation of seeing Jesus.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel-to-realm sequence described; only a transitional light phenomenon during loss of consciousness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Visualized what were recognized as distant car headlights approaching, then reversing and slowly extinguishing; explicitly 'waiting to see Jesus' but no encounter occurred.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “That was the last thought in my head before seeing a set of what I recognized to be headlights.”
